plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: A small deciduous tree that produces fragrant, five-petaled blossoms on bare branches in the depths of winter. Widely cultivated in East Asia for ornamental use and for its fruit, which is pickled or made into liqueur.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to early spring (January to March)
plants.location: China, Japan, Korea; cultivated in temperate gardens worldwide
plants.funFact: Ume blossoms are a symbol of perseverance in East Asian culture because they bloom while snow may still be on the ground, often before cherry blossoms.

plants.name: Galanthus nivalis
plants.description: A small bulbous perennial with nodding, bell-shaped white flowers marked with green spots on the inner petals. It pushes up through frost and snow, naturalizing in woodlands and gardens.
plants.location: Europe, from the Pyrenees to Ukraine; naturalized in the UK and North America
plants.funFact: Snowdrops contain galantamine, a compound used in medications to treat symptoms of Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Acacia pycnantha
plants.description: An evergreen shrub or small tree covered in fluffy, golden, ball-shaped flower clusters with a sweet scent. It grows in woodlands and dry forests of southeastern Australia.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late winter to spring in Australia (July to October), with some wattle species flowering in summer
plants.funFact: Golden wattle is Australia's national floral emblem, and National Wattle Day is celebrated on September 1.

plants.name: Agapanthus praecox
plants.description: A clump-forming perennial with strap-like leaves and tall stems topped by large rounded clusters of trumpet-shaped blue flowers. It thrives in warm, sunny conditions and is popular in borders and coastal gardens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Summer in the Southern Hemisphere (December to March)
plants.location: South Africa; widely cultivated in Australia, New Zealand, and Mediterranean climates
plants.funFact: Despite its common name, Agapanthus is not a true lily; its name comes from Greek words meaning 'love flower'.
